What's the largest dense (non-MoE) LLM ever publicly disclosed?
answer: PaLM, at 540 billion parameters, is the largest publicly disclosed dense (non-mixture-of-experts) language model. Announced by Google in 2022, it was trained on 780 billion tokens across 6144 TPU v4 chips. [PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.02311)
